instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace messy inline styles in admin components with standardized Tailwind utility classes from this blueprint.
2. Ensure all data tables keep headers and content text left-aligned, monetary values right-aligned with font-mono, and status actions/badges centered or right-aligned.
3. Keep primary brand accent orange (#E8792A / orange-500) focused on active nav items, key action buttons, focus rings, and highlighted KPI stat accents without oversaturating data tables.
4. Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, table rows, filter fields, and modal buttons.
5. Ensure forms, selects, modals, and toasts utilize custom styled Shadcn primitives.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
Never rely on pure transparent backgrounds over scrollable layers; use frosted glass backdrop-blur or solid surface colors.
Maintain uniform 8px/12px padding and strict button height ratios.
Always provide immediate tactile micro-feedback on buttons, table rows, and active menu items.
